name: Clamavus
oracle_text: Proclamator Hailer — Each creature you control gets +1/+1 for each +1/+1 counter on it.
blocked_sentences: Proclamator Hailer — Each creature you control gets +1/+1 for each +1/+1 counter on it.

needs.what: a static value leaf that reads the permanent the static is being applied to, so a `buff` can be sized per affected creature: `power`/`toughness` = `{"counters_on": {"counter": "+1/+1", "objects": "affected"}}` (each creature gets +1/+1 for each +1/+1 counter on ITSELF)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `counters_on` in static_value_keys reads counters off objects chosen relative to the static's SOURCE (`self_only` is Clamavus itself, a `count`-style filter sums over many permanents); `characteristics._static_value(state, expr, source)` is called in layer 7c with only `source_obj`, never the affected object, so every creature would get the same bonus. `AFFECTED_CONTROLLER` exists only for static conditions, not magnitudes. Writing one buff per counter count or using `has_counters` cannot scale with the number of counters.
